statusDetail:
Reconciled answer (both research tracks cross-audited, zero remaining disagreement).

CALLERS OF retryWithBackoff under src/ — exactly four files, all calling the single definition at src/net/retry.js:3:
- src/billing/charge.js — import :1, call :4
- src/billing/refund.js — import :1, call :4
- src/sync/pull.js — import :1, call :4
- src/sync/push.js — import :1, call :4

DEFAULT ATTEMPTS = 5, traced to its defining line: src/net/retry.js:4 'const attempts = options.attempts ?? DEFAULTS.attempts;' resolves to src/config.js:1 'export const DEFAULTS = { attempts: 5, baseDelayMs: 250 };'. DEFAULTS is written only at config.js:1 and read only at retry.js:1,4,5, so attempts is never mutated at runtime; the '??' also maps explicit null to 5.

EXPLICIT ATTEMPTS OVERRIDES — complete list of two:
- src/billing/charge.js:4 -> attempts: 2
- src/billing/refund.js:4 -> attempts: 3
The other two callers inherit 5: src/sync/pull.js:4 omits options entirely; src/sync/push.js:4 passes { baseDelayMs: 100 } only — options present but attempts absent, which reads as an override but is not one.

EXCLUSIONS (examined, non-calling): src/net/retry-sync.js:1 is a distinct symbol retryWithBackoffSync whose own positional default 'attempts = 1' is not an override of retryWithBackoff (zero importers, never delegates); src/legacy/old-sync.js:1 is a comment-only historical mention, oldSync at :2-4 makes no retry call.

INDIRECT TRACK (reading B) confirmed no aliased imports, no re-export barrels (no index.js; package.json has no main/exports), no second-order wrappers, and no consumers outside src/ — so the lexical list is complete and the caller graph does not extend.

Reconciliation: reading B agreed on all items and independently reproduced every value; reading A independently re-verified reading B's negative claims. One non-overturning correction: reading B cited package.json type=module at line 6, actual line 5. No source file was modified; FINDINGS.md left for Architect to write.
